name: Back Corté
notes: Owner's description (2026-11-17): slow, quick, quick, slow, the lead stepping directly backward and the feet closing on the last slow, turning a quarter to the left across the last two steps (45° each); starts and ends in closed position, from where the Closed Promenade ends. Named after the standard figure the owner agreed it matches. Differences from the book, kept as the owner dances it: the book's Back Corté starts on the lead's right foot and its third step is side and slightly forward; here the lead starts on his left (the Closed Promenade leaves him standing on his right) and every travelling step goes straight back. Lead: slow, left back; quick, right back past it; quick, left back and slightly to his right, turning 1/8 left; slow, right closes to the left, turning 1/8 left. The follow walks forward to match (right, left, right, left closes), turning with him. The model turns a close on each dancer's own standing foot rather than turning the couple about a shared centre, so the follow's third step is written as an offset (1.2 forward, 0.35 right) that brings her round him into closed hold, offset to his right, before the close (it was 1.3 and 0.25 before the offset hold, 2026-11-17). She is on the outside of the turn, so her step is the longer one. To share the travel (owner, 2026-11-17, after watching a video), the lead's third step is shortened a touch (0.9 back instead of 1.0) and taken slightly to the side (0.15 to his right, which is backward along his new facing), as the book's side step does: his stride on that quick is 0.41 from his standing foot and hers about 0.9 (it was 0.54 and 1.08 with his step straight back). Provisional (owner: same as the walks): strides of 0.5 from the standing foot, so the passing steps move 1.0. No rise. Timing: 2/4, a slow is one beat and a quick half. Exempt from the "hold" check (added 2026-11-17): after step 3 the follow is 0.32 from closed hold (to the lead's left of where the offset hold puts her) until the turning close brings her back. Her step 3 was tuned so the close ends in hold; a close that turns spins each dancer on their own foot, so it can't keep the hold on its own. Left for the figure clean-up (a couple turn that continues through the close is planned in the model). Remove skipChecks once it's fixed.
